title: ZenStatementCanonicalGraph
description: Canonical ZenStatement KB graph extracted from generated canonical bundle documents. Preserve explicit canonical IDs and relationships only.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Canonical KB nodes. Each node must correspond to an explicit canonical_id in the source document.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: Explicit canonical graph relationships from relationship lines in the source document.

canonical_id.title: Canonical Id
canonical_id.description: The exact canonical_id from the document. Do not rewrite or infer.

card_type.title: Card Type
card_type.description: The exact card_type from the document.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable card name when explicitly present.

platform_account_id.title: Platform Account Id
platform_account_id.description: Platform account scope if explicitly present.

platform_type.title: Platform Type
platform_type.description: Platform type such as marketplace, logistics, bank, payment, oms, or wms.

table_id.title: Table Id
table_id.description: Referenced table canonical_id if explicitly present.

metric_id.title: Metric Id
metric_id.description: Referenced metric canonical_id if explicitly present.

edge_type.title: Edge Type
edge_type.description: Exact uppercase canonical edge label, such as HAS_COLUMN, HAS_IMPLEMENTATION, or USES_TABLE.
